tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Check the banked token balance for the authenticated Pulse account. Requires PULSE_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_token_packs
tools.description: List the available Pulse token packs (tier label, token count, price). Use before purchase_token_pack to show options to the user.

tools.name: purchase_token_pack
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a Pulse token pack. Returns payment_url — DO NOT submit it programmatically; surface it to the user so they can complete payment in their browser. Once paid, banked tokens are credited automatically. Requires PULSE_API_KEY.

tools.name: search_open_loops
tools.description: Find released original synthesis kits and individually auditioned source samples by keyword, pack, BPM, key and licence. Automated checks are not listening review. Free; no account or tokens required. Source tags are creator hints. Preserve attribution when required and follow each sample’s licence.

tools.name: get_open_loop
tools.description: Get a released sample’s metadata, exact licence, attribution, preview and WAV download URLs. Free; no account or tokens required. Keep attribution when using the sample in a song.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_trial, estimate_cost, analyze_track, request_payment_link, get_job_status, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Private data: start_trial, estimate_cost, request_payment_link, get_job_status, get_token_balance, list_token_packs, purchase_token_pack, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Public sink: start_trial, analyze_track, purchase_token_pack · Destructive: analyze_track.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_trial, estimate_cost, analyze_track, request_payment_link, get_job_status, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Private data: start_trial, estimate_cost, request_payment_link, get_job_status, get_token_balance, list_token_packs, purchase_token_pack, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Public sink: start_trial, analyze_track, purchase_token_pack · Destructive: analyze_track

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
